Bug_Title: SF: Dead store due to switch statement fall through to throw (SF_DEAD_STORE_DUE_TO_SWITCH_FALLTHROUGH_TO_THROW)
Bug_Details:
A value stored in the previous switch case is ignored here due to a switch fall through to a place where
    an exception is thrown. It is likely that
    you forgot to put a break or return at the end of the previous case.
Bug_Explanation: A value stored in the previous switch case (input == 1) is ignored due to a switch fall through to a place where an exception is thrown. The value '10' assigned to the variable'result' is lost when the exception is thrown for any input other than 1.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case with input 2 triggers the bug because it falls through to the next case in the switch statement without a break, causing the value '10' assigned to the variable'result' to be lost when the exception is thrown.
